instruction: boltons.timeutils' US timezone objects (Eastern, Central, Mountain, Pacific) ignore datetime.fold at the end of daylight saving time, when the local hour between 1:00 and 2:00 occurs twice. With tzinfo=Eastern, datetime(2011, 11, 6, 1, 30, fold=0) must be EDT (UTC-4) and the same time with fold=1 must be EST (UTC-5). Converting from UTC must set fold correctly: 2011-11-06 05:30 UTC becomes 01:30 EDT with fold 0, and 06:30 UTC becomes 01:30 EST with fold 1. The historical DST rules for earlier years must keep working. Fix it and add tests.
